## Clean data

```{r}
#| label: extract data

expression <- Biobase::exprs(GSE24504_raw)
# columns ("GSM60...") = samples (one sample of one organ of one mouse after one time)
# rows (1 to 22680) = number of microarray probe
# values = normalized log2 ratio Cy3/Cy5 (test/reference)

samples <- Biobase::pData(GSE24504_raw)
# description of the samples

genes <- Biobase::fData(GSE24504_raw)


```

```{r}
#| label: new dataframe

samples_clean <- samples |> 
  select(title, 
         geo_accession, 
         source_name_ch1, 
         `mouse:ch1`,
         `timepoint:ch1`,
         `tissue:ch1`) |> 
  rename(mouse = `mouse:ch1`,
         timepoint = `timepoint:ch1`,
         tissue = `tissue:ch1`)


expression_entrezid <- expression |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "ID") |> 
  full_join(genes |> 
              dplyr::mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) |> 
              select(ENTREZ_ID, ID, FLAG),
            by = "ID") |> 
  dplyr::relocate(ENTREZ_ID, FLAG, .before = 1) |> 
  filter(FLAG == "0") |> 
  select(-ID, -FLAG)


expression_long <- expression_entrezid |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -ENTREZ_ID, 
               names_to = "geo_accession", 
               values_to = "expression")
```

```{r}
#| label: join for final dataframe

dat_clean_long <- full_join(samples_clean, expression_long, by = "geo_accession") 

dat_avg <- dat_clean_long |>
  filter(!is.na(ENTREZ_ID)) |>
  group_by(title, geo_accession, source_name_ch1, mouse, timepoint, tissue, ENTREZ_ID) |>
  summarise(expression = mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

write.table(
  x = dat_avg,
  file = "../data/data_aug",
  sep = "\t"
)
```
